svg.title: Hero Warriors
svg.desc: Two rows of five project marks: Kamailio, Debian, Docker, Linux, GNU, Python, YAML, SQLite, OpenSSL and Netfilter.
svg.metadata: Upstream artwork; project marks retain their respective ownership and terms. Debian Open Use Logo by Raul Silva, (c) 1999 Software in the Public Interest, Inc.; https://www.debian.org/logos/ Docker: docker-mark-ocean-blue.svg from https://www.docker.com/static/Docker-Logos-1.zip Python Software Foundation: https://www.python.org/community/logos/ SQLite: https://www.sqlite.org/images/sqlite370_banner.svg OpenSSL: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/master/doc/images/openssl.svg Kamailio, Linux, GNU and YAML outlines: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/develop/icons Tux by Larry Ewing; the Bold GNU Head by Aurelio A. Heckert. Netfilter: traced from the project's flame at https://www.netfilter.org/images/netfilter-logo3.png
